scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Exact assertion about the indicated integral cubic model and its characteristic-five fiber. A classical one-nodal cubic has well-known geometry, so the new claim is the explicit split arithmetic, six doubled points of the relative Fano scheme, and all-extension zeta formula together; equivalent unindexed treatments remain a priority risk. Independent audit not performed.
